- Improved error-path trace writing: when `--trace-output` is requested but execution fails before a specific block can be identified, the trace now reports `error_line_number: 1` and still includes a meaningful `initial_state` in `output/main.py`.
- Ensured trace error locations are always populated on program errors (falls back to the last source line seen) in `output/simulator.py`.

Run via `python main.py --input <file> --output <out.json>` (optionally add `--trace-output ...` plus exactly one stepping flag).
